summary.text: Matt Rinker, listed by Ballotpedia as Matthew Rinker, is a Republican state representative from Iowa House District 99 who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as business owner and insurance agent, and he served in the U.S. Navy from 2004 to 2008.

paragraphs.text: Matt Rinker was born in Burlington, Iowa, and graduated from Burlington Community High School in 2003.

He served in the U.S. Navy from 2004 to 2008, earned an associate degree in general studies from Southeastern Community College in 2010, and earned a bachelor's degree in political science and government from Western Illinois University.
His career experience includes owning a business and working as an insurance agent.
Rinker lost the June 2, 2020 Republican primary for Iowa State Senate District 44 to Tim Goodwin.
He defeated incumbent Democrat Dennis Cohoon in the November 8, 2022 general election for Iowa House District 99, and won re-election over Jim Beres on November 5, 2024.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia shows him assigned to the Labor, Public Safety and House Veterans Affairs committees.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Jennifer Kirkman in the general election.
